**In one line**: OpenAI has reportedly released two new GPT-6 models, Sol and Luna, and cut API pricing to about half that of the prior generation.

### Key points
- OpenAI is said to have introduced two models — 'Sol' and 'Luna' — under the GPT-6 line.
- The headline change is API pricing, reportedly down roughly 50% versus the previous generation.
- Both models were reportedly published alongside benchmark performance figures.

### Why it matters
If the price cut holds up, inference costs for services built on GPT models drop by half overnight, changing the economics of high-volume and agent workloads that were previously shelved over cost. It signals a shift in the model race from raw capability toward unit price.
